title: Fields shared by every item type

id.description: Stable identifier, and the file name. Generated: from the key for a mirrored type, otherwise from the title or a chosen slug.

title.description: One line. What this is, readable on its own in a list.

tags.description: Lowercase, hyphenated. For grouping that no field already captures. Well-known tags, which other tools and plugins read: decision (a decision and its reasoning, on a note with a project), finding (a fact established by investigating), learned (something learned that is worth sharing with the team), report (a generated report, such as a status), meta (friction with the instructions themselves), session (where a session stopped, for a later one to pick up). Any other tag is free-form.

archived.description: Moved out of the active set. The file moves to the archive directory; nothing is deleted.

completed_at.description: (task, project, pr) When this reached a finished state: stamped by the server on the change, and cleared if it is reopened. Search on it for what was finished in a period. Set it only to record work finished earlier.

archive_after_days.description: How long this lingers before it is archived. On a task, project or pr it overrides the default, counted from completed_at. On a note it is the only expiry, counted from the last change, so setting it means that many days from now. 0 archives it on the next pass.

pinned.description: Never archive automatically. For things that stay in the active set regardless of status.
